tasks.short: Consult specialists when care exceeds midwifery expertise

steps.what: Find the actual patient's current observations, relevant history and local specialist contact using existing record views
inputs: Actual patient record and existing specialist directory
outputs: Verified patient context and contact

steps.what: Assess the actual condition, scope limits and urgency and decide which specialist needs to be consulted
inputs: Actual patient assessment and verified context
outputs: Clinical consultation decision and actual question

steps.what: Consult the actual specialist by telephone, communicate observations and urgency, clarify advice and agree the patient's next clinical steps
inputs: Actual clinical question and specialist conversation
outputs: Actual clinical advice, unresolved issues and agreed next steps

steps.what: Write the required clinical entry about the consultation that actually occurred, including advice, uncertainty and next steps
inputs: Actual completed consultation and verified patient identity
outputs: Accurate consultation entry in the clinical record

steps.what: Save the completed consultation entry in the same clinical record
inputs: Completed actual consultation entry
outputs: Stored entry

tasks.design: Use {OPS_SYSTEM} patient views and its actual specialist directory to assemble context for a telephone consultation. The midwife assesses urgency, speaks with the specialist and writes the actual subsequent clinical entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant observations and contact details may require separate navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing patient views and directory filters can reduce that navigation without interpreting the condition.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical scope, urgency and specialist advice remain human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise deterioration and communicate the patient's circumstances accurately.

ambition.what: Improve context access for the existing consultation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record views and directories can filter existing observations and contacts; they do not replace specialist consultation.

assumptions: Illustrative telephone-consultation episode, not a measured baseline or an estimate of the mix between consultations and written referrals. OPS_SYSTEM is the existing clinical record. Actual clinicians produce observations during existing care; s1 includes reading and checking them, and missing observations require real clinical assessment rather than a free feed.

The required consultation entry is split out of the conversation in s4. No written referral is concealed in the call or save. A real written referral would need its own final document, actual authorised review and separate gated send before its benefit could be estimated.
Try existing patient and contact views first. If already used, their runtime benefit is zero. No automated diagnosis, triage or clinical advice is proposed.

Shares are task-specific illustrative effort, independent of prompt time priors. The minimum integer share 1 for the ordinary same-system save represents negligible time, is fully retained and yields no saving or self-approval.
unknowns: Are usable patient and contact views already in routine use?
How much real time is spent locating context rather than assessing it?
research_questions: Observe real consultations and distinguish context navigation, clinical assessment, conversation and actual record writing.

already_counted.description: Clinical context checking, assessment, actual specialist consultation and subsequent entry including ordinary save remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain contact links and check view omissions, additional to retained case work.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: navigation 15*(1-.80)=3, less 1 additional upkeep =2. Low: the patient's relevant observations are dispersed in unindexed narrative or contact views already cover them, so all 15 navigation points remain; with no useful configuration deployed, no new upkeep and no saving. The 20 assessment, 60 call, 4 entry and 1 save stay fully retained in both cases. Unmeasured conditional scenarios.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read current midwifery literature and discuss developments with colleagues

steps.what: Search actual literature databases and professional sources for the current midwifery question using saved topic filters
inputs: Actual learning question and database records
outputs: Candidate original literature and provenance links

steps.what: Read the original articles, assess study limitations and decide whether findings apply to actual midwifery practice
inputs: Actual full text and study methods
outputs: Personal critical understanding and unresolved questions

steps.what: Discuss the actual findings and uncertainties with colleagues during the existing professional learning exchange
inputs: Read studies and colleagues' actual experience
outputs: Clarified understanding and remaining questions

steps.what: Write the actual working learning note, using existing citation fields to insert verified source references
inputs: Actual learning conclusions and checked bibliographic records
outputs: Working note with verified references

steps.what: Save the working learning note in its existing document location
inputs: Completed working note
outputs: Stored working note

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in {OTHER}, the existing literature database and reference manager, and use checked citation fields in {DOCS}. Original reading, applicability assessment and colleague discussion remain with the midwife.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated database navigation and reference entry interrupt actual reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic filters and reference fields can reduce that clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Research relevance and changes to clinical understanding cannot be inferred from search results.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise weak evidence and relate findings to actual patients.

ambition.what: Support existing professional learning without producing clinical recommendations automatically.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved literature searches and reference-manager citation fields can reduce retrieval and bibliography work.

assumptions: This is an actual literature-reading and colleague-discussion episode with an existing working note. No conference travel, membership administration or report after every professional conversation is invented or extrapolated.

Publishers and database providers produce the source records; s1 counts retrieval and identity checks, s2 full-text access and critical reading, s4 citation checking and actual note writing. Missing full text or metadata remains manual; no freely curated evidence pack is assumed.

Native search and reference features are tried first; existing use has no new benefit. No model-generated evidence summary or invented source is accepted. No publication or policy release occurs here.
Shares are unmeasured task-specific effort. The same-system save has minimum integer share 1, fully retained, negligible actual time and no approval or saving.
unknowns: Which databases index the midwifery questions adequately?
Does the actual note already use reference-manager fields?
research_questions: Measure search refinement and citation effort separately from original reading and clinical interpretation.

already_counted.description: Actual search checking, original reading, discussion, note writing and ordinary save remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Refresh saved topic searches and repair stale reference links beyond retained per-source checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: 20*.30+9*.20=7.8 gross less 2 upkeep =5.8. Low: weak subject indexing requires 18 of the 20 search points for manual query refinement rather than 14; verified citation fields still save 1.8, giving 2+1.8-2=1.8. All 50 reading and assessment points, 20 discussion points and the save remain. Metadata missing from individual sources is checked manually within retained note work. Unmeasured scenarios, not a common percentage cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct student midwives, medical students or residents on the birthing process

steps.what: Read the actual learner's objectives and relevant existing teaching guidance using the learning system's topic and level filters
inputs: Actual learning objectives and existing teaching guidance
outputs: Checked teaching context

steps.what: Instruct the actual learner on the birthing process, demonstrate appropriate skills, observe practice and give immediate tailored feedback
inputs: Actual learner, real learning setting and checked objectives
outputs: Actual instruction, observation and feedback

steps.what: Enter the actual required learner observation after teaching, distinguishing observed performance from activities merely discussed
inputs: Actual completed instruction and observed learner performance
outputs: Accurate existing learning record entry

steps.what: Save the entry in the same learning record
inputs: Completed observation entry
outputs: Stored learning entry

tasks.design: Use existing {LMS} objective filters and {DOCS} teaching references to retrieve the right material. Keep instruction, observed performance, feedback and the actual subsequent learning entry with the midwife.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learner objectives and teaching references may be found through separate searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing learning-system views can link objective levels to actual guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Instruction must respond to the actual learner and clinical setting.
tasks.human_edge: Observe competence and explain why a particular birthing action is appropriate.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation navigation for existing instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning systems can filter existing objectives and teaching resources while observations and instruction remain human work.

assumptions: Representative actual teaching episode with a required learner entry; no additional assessment report is invented. Programme staff maintain existing objectives and clinical educators maintain existing guidance in their normal work; s1 includes checking and adapting their relevance, not a free prepared lesson.

S3 records the teaching after it happened; it does not certify independent practice. If formal certification or a written assessment submission is required, include its actual independent authority and separate gated action rather than treating this save as certification.

No patient-care action is delegated to software. Actual clinical care during teaching retains its normal staff and physical effort; preparation occurs at its real frequency rather than charging a full course redesign to every lesson.

Try native objective views first; existing functionality already used has zero new benefit. The save is minimum integer share 1, negligible and fully retained, with no author self-gate. Shares are illustrative and not derived from the prompt time prior.
unknowns: Are learner objectives actually mapped to teaching resources?
Which learner entries are already required for this instruction?
research_questions: Observe instruction and separately time actual preparation navigation and required observation entry.

already_counted.description: Checking objectives, actual teaching, observation entry and ordinary save remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Repair resource links beyond retained lesson-specific checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: 10*.20=2 navigation points less .5 extra link upkeep =1.5. Low: the learner's level is not mapped to existing resources, so the midwife still performs all 10 preparation points; do not deploy an unhelpful view or incur its upkeep. All 80 instruction, 9 actual entry and 1 save points remain. This is a mapping-availability case, not a shared reduction factor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish specialty practice guidelines for women, childbearing families and newborns

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual source guidance, existing local pathways, revision dates and the specialty scope for the proposed guideline
inputs: Actual source guidelines and local practice requirements
outputs: Checked sources and explicit specialty scope

steps.what: Establish the actual proposed clinical recommendations, exclusions and escalation criteria for the specialty practice guideline
inputs: Verified sources and actual local care context
outputs: Author's clinical recommendations with evidence and uncertainty

steps.what: Populate the actual guideline template's explicitly mapped source references, section identifiers and revision fields from verified values
inputs: S1 verified metadata and s2 explicit section mapping
outputs: Guideline shell with exact mapped fields and missing-field list

steps.what: Write the specialty guideline narrative with a bounded draft helper using only the midwife's actual recommendations and verified sources
inputs: Actual clinical recommendations, verified sources and populated shell
outputs: Source-linked guideline narrative with unsupported claims rejected

loop.input: S1 sources and s2 actual recommendations
loop.output: Proposed wording linked to the supplied sources
loop.check: Midwife checks every clinical sentence against the chosen recommendation and original source
loop.stop: Reject unsupported or contradictory wording and complete manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Clinical explanatory prose varies; fixed fields remain deterministic in s3

steps.what: Check the complete proposed guideline for clinical consistency, applicability, references and revision metadata and save its final review version
inputs: Complete guideline draft
outputs: Final review version with exact content and revision identity

steps.what: Save that final review version in the same document system without releasing it
inputs: Final review version
outputs: Stored final review version

steps.what: Review the completed final specialty guideline and decide whether to authorise that exact revision for clinical use
inputs: S6 stored final version including scope, recommendations and revision identity
outputs: Actual approval or rejection of the exact final revision

steps.what: Publish only the exact independently authorised final guideline revision into the existing clinical guideline library
inputs: Exact final guideline revision and s7 valid clinical release authority
outputs: Established clinical guideline with approved version and publication result

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} to populate checked fixed fields and draft explanatory prose around recommendations actually selected by the midwife. After the complete final revision exists, the actual independent clinical guideline authority reviews it; publishing into {OPS_SYSTEM}, the clinical guideline library, is its own gated action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guideline fields and explanatory prose require repeated composition while source and clinical checks remain essential.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit field mappings are deterministic; a bounded wording helper can use an actual recommendation set without making clinical decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence interpretation, specialty applicability and clinical release remain actual clinical responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible recommendations and recognise when source evidence does not fit the care setting.

ambition.what: Reduce guideline composition effort within the existing clinical governance process.

reach.task: Review the actual completed guideline for release
reach.learn: Which scope or evidence gaps prevent authorisation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can populate explicit verified fields and bounded drafting can suggest wording; neither establishes clinical validity.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual source-guidance repository. Source publishers and local clinical owners produce guidance in their normal work; s1 retrieves and checks it, s2 performs clinical reasoning and field mapping. No free evidence pack or automated recommendation is assumed.

The 15-point field-transfer baseline is conditional on observed manual population of an actual guideline template; if native linked fields already perform it, count no new benefit. No ordinary same-system save is priced as significant work.

S5 is author checking, not approval. S6 is an ordinary ungated save, minimum integer share 1 fully retained. S7 must be the organisation's actual independent guideline authority, never the author approving herself; the 5 other-role points are explicit retained work, not focal savings. If no such existing authority or release route exists, do not invent one or publish; map the real governance workflow first.

The final version exists before s7. Any content, scope, reference or revision change invalidates a1 and requires s5-s7 again. S8 is a distinct clinical-library publication, not the ordinary same-system save. Additional messages or distribution actions require their own actual final-version gates and are not hidden in publication.
Illustrative baseline has 95 focal-role points and 5 other-role points; normalise savings to 95. Neither shares nor savings are measured or inferred from prompt time priors.
unknowns: Which fields are actually entered manually today?
Who holds actual independent guideline release authority?
Which document controls and source metadata survive publication?
research_questions: Observe one real guideline revision from source retrieval through actual release and count author revisions and independent authority time separately.

already_counted.description: Retained source work, clinical recommendations, prose review, complete author check, ordinary save and actual publication total 74 focal points out of 95.
Independent clinical guideline authority review remains 5 points, equivalent to 5/95 of focal baseline; no saving claimed.

incremental.description: Maintain source-to-template mappings and sample wording-helper errors beyond retained guideline checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final specialty guideline stored in s6, including recommendations, scope, source references and revision identity; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: 15 exact-field points plus 20*.30=6 prose points saved =21/95*100=22.105, less 3 focal upkeep =19.105, rounded down to19.1. Low: source metadata lacks stable section identifiers, leaving 9 of the 15 field points manual, and clinical wording needs 18 of 20 prose points; only 6+2=8 points save, 8/95*100-3=5.421, rounded down to5.4. All source assessment, recommendation choice, complete author check, save, independent review and publication remain. A metadata and wording constraint specific to guideline drafting; unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Actual specialists retain consultation and clinical advice
Learners receive actual observation and tailored instruction
Independent clinical guideline authority retains final release decisions
skills_to_grow: Separate source navigation from clinical assessment
Check bibliographic and guideline revision metadata
Distinguish author checking, ordinary saving and actual clinical publication authority
role.ambitious_version: A midwife who spends less effort finding and composing existing information while retaining clinical care, teaching and guideline judgement.
